description: This uniquepipebracket fits a wide variety of design styles including industrial, loft, modern, contemporary, farmhouse and more. The industrial pipe bracket measures 1.5 inches wide and is available in the following bracket sizes 5 x 7, 6 x 8, 7 x 9, 8 x 10, 9 x 11 & 10 x 12. The L-bracket is made of 1/4-inch thick material and bent at 90-degrees. You can choose from 4 finish options including Black; Aged Bronze; Aged Pewter; or Clear Coat (over raw metal). Want to paint this corbel yourself?
